description: One first maximal rising run is red in EACH of the four input routes. Their actual grid lengths are 4sqrt2,3sqrt2,2sqrt2,sqrt2. The shared role (one straight run) is the proposed false unit: count runs instead of summing unit diagonals, favoring the two-run A. No complete option is emphasized and all competitor routes retain original continuous black ink.
